title: Amazon just became the world's most valuable company, ending Microsoft's spot at the top after five weeks (MSFT, AAPL, AMZN)
text:
11 hours ago )
Amazon has stolen Microsoft's crown as the world's most valuable company.
On Tuesday, the Seattle-based online retail giant capped a strong holiday sales period with a 3% pop in its stock price, bringing its market capitalization to $793 billion and edging past Microsoft's roughly $788 billion valuation.
